整体色彩以玉绿、冷青、乳白、淡粉为主，雨天环境光偏冷，花瓣透过日光提供暖白柔和的透射光，在人物皮肤和湿润衣料上形成细腻高光。摄影机采用低机位35mm中大全景。画面情绪轻松、亲密、生活化。重点表现一个暂时停顿却仍有目标的瞬间:雨挡住了她们继续追赶，但也让长纱因为吸水变重，不再继续飘远。
schemes.en: [Simulated English for interface testing, not a validated translation.] A cinematic live-action scene under a large ivory lotus petal. Three women in pale cyan wet robes shelter from the rain; one lifts the petal, one steps across a flooded vein, and another reaches back to help. A wet pale-pink scarf clings to a green stem outside. Cool rain light contrasts with soft warm light transmitted through the petal. A low-angle 35mm medium-wide shot, calm and intimate.
